name: 丁原智
objective: This course focus on the characteristics of various minerals extraction including mining methods and the equipment. The topics include exploration, reserve estimation, mine development, exploitation, surface mining and underground mining. The lab sessions include selection of mining method, explosive and blasting, cost evaluation and field trip.
schedule:
1		Introduction to mining-element of mining

3		Economics of mineral industries
4		Prospecting-general and geologic
5		Prospecting-Geophysical and Geochemical
6		Exploration methods
7		Feasibility study(1)
8		Feasibility study(2)
9		Mid-term
10		Mine development-general

12 	        Financing and taxation
13		Exploitation-general
14		Exploitation-mining method

18		Final
